contract.poses: World-space PoseData; metres/radians; [x,y,z,w] quaternions. Both ends are canonical low.
contract.contacts: Every frame stores points and normals in the ORIGINAL primitive-entry object material coordinates. They are not pre-rotated to the world-aligned exit box.
contract.physicalOrientation: QY(cubeAngle), including all non-TURN recovery frames. y=-pi/2; y-prime=+pi/2. cubeAngle stays at the completed turn throughout recovery.
contract.turnAdapter: TURN: pass rotation Move(y/y-prime), angle=cubeAngle, orientation=identity to contact measurement. Five holder contacts are drive; the clear receiving hand has no contact claims.
contract.staticAdapter: For non-TURN support measurement choose EITHER (A) original contacts + no move + angle=0 + orientation=QY(cubeAngle), OR (B) transform each point/normal exactly once by QY(cubeAngle), then no move + angle=0 + identity orientation. Do not combine A and B.
contract.renderAdapter: Keep the original facelets with actual QY(cubeAngle), or an equivalent identity orientation plus held y move angle; during recovery do not reverse the object when the released hand returns.
contract.logicalCommit: At completed primitive only, apply y/y-prime to logical facelets and atomically reset physical render orientation. Rebase contacts to canonical low. Independent 54-slot permutation and 54 rendered colored stickers match this exact commit.
contract.endpointConvention: Every segment includes its exact start/end pose; linearly interpolate positions/joints and slerp wrists. 65 nodes and all 64 interpolation midpoints were checked. Preserve group order.

limitations: Bounded sampled STL vertex/containment and existing upper/forearm proxies, not continuous triangle intersection proof.
Three actual non-collinear measured contacts certify visual support only, not physical force closure, friction, torque, speed or hardware feasibility.
Rigid-both control covers the turn only. Only full handoff mode can claim complete low-to-low geometry.
No runtime production integration or final browser appearance checked here.
